encoder: Official TorchAudio2.6.0+cpu WAV2VEC2_ASR_BASE_960H, frozen, eval, CPU one thread
external_pretraining: LibriSpeech960h audio, then ASR on corresponding transcripts; not target CREMA training. No proof of arbitrary population independence or complete pretraining cost is claimed.
weights_license: MIT, explicitly stated for model weights in official2.6 documentation; kept outside source artifacts
physical_prefix: origin=max(native audio start, first video PTS); native crop ceil((origin-audio_start)*rate-1e-7) through floor((origin+1-audio_start)*rate+1e-7), crop before resample_poly, constant edge padding, at most2 final samples zero padded, final16000 samples. No end-of-recording normalization or postprefix context.
descriptor: Final49x768 hidden mean and population std plus four consecutive nearly equal temporal-bin29-dimensional CTC-logit means:1652 frozen features. Official29-class auxiliary conversion retained. Greedy CTC is diagnostic only, never a classifier selection signal.
target: DFA=0,IOM=1 from sentence and clip fields; inherited COHORT.label denotes emotion and must never become the sentence target
train: Same288 pinned clips from24 actors,2 sentences,6 emotions; train-only manifest is frozen
actor_crossfit: Four sorted-unique-actor roundrobin folds;18 fit actors/6 held actors each. Feature standardization fitted on fold-training clips only.
head: Binary logistic C=1, L2 weights, unpenalized intercept; no hyperparameter selection or pooled OOF recalibration
full_head: Same fixed C=1 on all288 train features after crossfitting
relations: NewA with fixed R1nestedT and R1nestedV: separately trained AT_unique([pA,pT,pA*pT]) and AVT(seven ordinary polynomial probability features), C=1, original relation y/sample_weight. Fit only training OOF probabilities.
paired_pretrained_video_extension: Anew+Vpretrained+T is a separate prospective joint candidate requiring provider OOF/full-head hashes and its own candidate freeze before dev. It cannot replace the frozen primary video attribution with R1A/T.
development: Only original historically exposed six validation actors, loaded after source/head publication. No1019, oldtest or new independent-population claim.
audio_gate: Frozen sentence accuracy>=0.90 on original six-actor development. Still not independent population or full multimodal adoption qualification.
relation_inference: Preserve actor-block paired AVT-AT_unique accuracy/Brier bootstrap,10000 resamples seed20261110; descriptive historical-development evidence
source_and_candidate_gate: Remote source/protocol/checkpoint identity publication before target fit; remote all-head candidate publication before any development labels/features
cost: Outer wait4 receipts include acquisition, model load, media decoding, feature extraction, all head fits and failures. Body CPU excluding decoder children is not a full cost. One-second observation and encoder inference are distinct latency terms.
